title: Fourier-Optics Intuition Benchmark: Gate 1
description:
First archived snapshot of the Fourier-optics intuition benchmark. It includes the NumPy simulator, numerical validation, mathematical audits, and the Gate 1 review gallery with 72 development examples. This release contains numerical groundwork and review materials; no models have been evaluated.
